pack: Zagros Basin infrastructure and landmark props (B3)
pipeline: tools/art/bldkit_b.py + tools/art/prop_zb_common.py + civic surfaces of tools/art/env_civic_3d.py (shared kit)
method: code-placed primitives in Blender 5.2 (bpy) with procedural tileable numpy surfaces; Cycles CPU bake of colour x AO into one atlas per prop (256-1024 px); GLB export; review contact sheet rendered with Workbench from the re-imported GLBs
tools: Blender 5.2 (bpy), numpy, Pillow - no AI image generation, no external textures or scans
content_notes: Fictional, generic designs. No real-world logos, brands, writing, flags, religious symbols or protected emblems; fascias and sign panels carry plain colour fields only; rolling stock carries stripes only.
conventions: 1 unit = 1 m; origin = footprint centre at ground level (rail stock: formation level, rail head at 0.67 m); long props run along Godot Z; tunnel portal faces Godot +Z (out of the mountain), locomotive cab end is +Z.
generated_at_runtime: Road carriageways, track (ballast, sleepers, rails) and power-line conductors are generated by godot/scripts/map_infra.gd from map.json with procedural shaders (road_surface.gdshader, rail_drape.gdshader); no textures.

items.description: Concrete tunnel headwall 18 m wide with a horseshoe opening, arch ring, pilasters, stepped wing walls, cover slab and a dark recess 1.6 m inside (tunnel not traversable)
18 m diesel road-switcher locomotive, faded blue-grey with cream and yellow stripes, no lettering
13 m tank wagon, dark grey barrel with a pale band, dome, walkway, ladders
15 m covered goods wagon, rust-brown corrugated box, curved roof, sliding doors
15 m flat wagon with two plain 20 ft containers (blue, red)
40 m passenger platform with yellow safety line, lamp posts (emissive lamp heads), benches, glazed shelter
24 m two-arch limestone rail bridge (single track): spandrel walls, arch rings, cutwaters, parapets, end pillars
34 m three-arch limestone road bridge, 9 m carriageway, kerbs, parapets, end pillars and wing walls
16 m town water tower: four concrete legs with bracing rings, white steel tank, walkway, ladder
Roadside fuel station: canopy with plain teal fascia (no brand), two pump islands, kiosk, blank sign pylon
28 m three-legged lattice phone mast with sector panels, link dishes, cabinets, fenced base, beacon
40 m square lattice radio mast in red/white aviation bands, beacon, equipment hut
34 m tapered brick factory chimney on a concrete plinth with steel bands and ladder
Three 16 m galvanised silos with conical roofs, lattice elevator tower and conveyor gallery
Two 6.5 m vertical fuel tanks inside a concrete bund wall with pipes and ladder
Rail-mounted yellow container gantry spanning 22 m, trolley, cab, spreader, warning lamps
Two rows of 40 ft containers stacked 2 and 3 high, plain faded colours, no markings
4 m mud-plaster compound wall segment on a stone footing with flat coping
6 m chain-link fence panel with galvanised posts and barbed-wire outriggers
